-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Render API key and connectivity.

render-get-user.name: render-get-user
render-get-user.description: Get the authenticated Render user info.

render-list-owners.name: render-list-owners
render-list-owners.description: List all workspaces/owners (personal and team accounts) accessible to the authenticated user.

render-list-projects.name: render-list-projects
render-list-projects.description: List all projects in the Render account.

render-get-project.name: render-get-project
render-get-project.description: Get detailed information about a specific Render project.

render-create-project.name: render-create-project
render-create-project.description: Create a new project in Render. Use render-list-owners to get the ownerId.

params.name: Project name
params.ownerId: Owner/workspace ID (use render-list-owners to get IDs)

render-delete-project.name: render-delete-project
render-delete-project.description: Delete a Render project. This action is irreversible!

params.projectId: The Render project ID to delete

render-list-environments.name: render-list-environments
render-list-environments.description: List all environments in a Render project.

render-create-environment.name: render-create-environment
render-create-environment.description: Create a new environment in a Render project.

render-list-services.name: render-list-services
render-list-services.description: List all services in the Render account. Optionally filter by type or name.

params.type: Filter by service type: web_service, static_site, background_worker, private_service, cron_job
params.name: Filter by service name (partial match)

render-get-service.name: render-get-service
render-get-service.description: Get detailed information about a specific Render service.

render-create-service.name: render-create-service
render-create-service.description: Create a new service on Render from a GitHub repository. Use render-list-owners to get ownerId.

params.name: Service name
params.ownerId: Owner/workspace ID (use render-list-owners to get IDs)
params.type: Service type: web_service, static_site, background_worker, private_service, cron_job
params.startCommand: Start command for web/worker services (e.g., "node server.js")

render-delete-service.name: render-delete-service
render-delete-service.description: Delete a Render service. This action is irreversible!

params.serviceId: The Render service ID to delete

render-suspend-service.name: render-suspend-service
render-suspend-service.description: Suspend a running Render service (stops billing for compute).

params.serviceId: The Render service ID to suspend
The Render service ID to resume
The Render service ID to restart

render-list-deploys.name: render-list-deploys
render-list-deploys.description: List recent deploys for a Render service.

params.limit: Maximum number of deploys to return (default: 10, max: 100)

render-get-deploy.name: render-get-deploy
render-get-deploy.description: Get the status and details of a specific Render deploy.

render-trigger-deploy.name: render-trigger-deploy
render-trigger-deploy.description: Trigger a new deploy for a Render service.

params.clearCache: Whether to clear the build cache: "clear" or "do_not_clear" (default: do_not_clear)

params.deployId: The Render deploy ID to cancel

render-rollback-deploy.name: render-rollback-deploy
render-rollback-deploy.description: Roll back a Render service to a specific previous deploy.

params.deployId: The deploy ID to roll back to

render-list-env-vars.name: render-list-env-vars
render-list-env-vars.description: List environment variables for a Render service.

render-set-env-vars.name: render-set-env-vars
render-set-env-vars.description: Set (replace all) environment variables for a Render service. This replaces ALL existing variables. Use render-update-env-var to update a single variable.

params.envVars: Array of environment variables to set

render-update-env-var.name: render-update-env-var
render-update-env-var.description: Add or update a single environment variable for a Render service.

render-delete-env-var.name: render-delete-env-var
render-delete-env-var.description: Delete an environment variable from a Render service.

render-list-custom-domains.name: render-list-custom-domains
render-list-custom-domains.description: List custom domains configured for a Render service.

render-add-custom-domain.name: render-add-custom-domain
render-add-custom-domain.description: Add a custom domain to a Render service.

render-delete-custom-domain.name: render-delete-custom-domain
render-delete-custom-domain.description: Remove a custom domain from a Render service.

params.domainId: The custom domain ID to remove

render-verify-custom-domain.name: render-verify-custom-domain
render-verify-custom-domain.description: Verify DNS configuration for a custom domain on a Render service.

params.domainId: The custom domain ID to verify

render-list-disks.name: render-list-disks
render-list-disks.description: List persistent disks attached to a Render service.

render-add-disk.name: render-add-disk
render-add-disk.description: Add a persistent disk to a Render service (useful for databases and stateful apps).

render-get-logs.name: render-get-logs
render-get-logs.description: Get recent logs for one or more Render services. Requires the owner ID (use render-list-owners) and service IDs.

params.ownerId: The owner/workspace ID (use render-list-owners to get IDs)
params.serviceIds: Array of service IDs to get logs from
params.limit: Maximum number of log lines to return (default: 100)
params.level: Filter by log level: debug, info, warning, error

name: Render
description: Deploy and manage services on Render directly from Teros workspaces. Supports web services, static sites, deployments, environment variables, custom domains, and more.

changelog.notes: Initial release — deploy services from GitHub, trigger and roll back deploys, manage env vars, custom domains, disks and logs
